title: Deploy the sites at a glance

cards.title: Deploy the sites
cards.text: One script releases louis-agent.dev and framework.louis-agent.dev to Azure Container Apps.

cards.title: Every merge releases
cards.text: A workflow signs in without a password and releases both sites, louis-agent.dev first.

cards.title: From the PC
cards.text: The same verbs after az login, from src\site: release, build, update and logs.

cards.title: An app's secrets
cards.text: From its git-ignored file into the vault; the app holds only references.

cards.title: The first time
cards.text: Fill the app's secrets file and put it in the vault; the next merge creates the app.

cards.title: A domain
cards.text: The records Cloudflare needs, DNS-only, then a managed certificate.

cards.title: From nothing
cards.text: main.bicep through infra, on a person's yes, then secrets, release and domain.

cards.title: Rolling back
cards.text: Activate the revision before by its name, or re-run an older Deploy the apps run.
